# Copilot entry point

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the canonical repository rules,
including operating mode, live safety, documentation, validation, API/feature
contract synchronization, and dependency licensing. Do not duplicate that
contract here.

For budget-aware research/implementation/testing use `.github/agent-budget.json`
and `fst-budget-workflow`. Database tasks still require `database-management`
and only the relevant focused advisors. PostgreSQL and artifact-only analytics
use their existing specialists.

Autonomous plan execution remains explicitly invoked with its existing model
and approval contract. Neither budget routing nor a research recommendation
authorizes production mutation, deployment, or a bypass of live-scrape parity.
